newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see distant demand on drought fears.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see distant demand on drought fears.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw increased demand for more distant positions this afternoon on fears drought in Southern Europe could cause rising grains prices, market sources said.

"The dry spell in Spain, Portugal and France could damage grain crops which could lead to higher prices. Therefore demand for summer and winter positions picked up this afternoon despite the strong dollar and a weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening," one broker said.
May Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $291 and May/Sept at $291 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $142, April and April/June both at $141 and April/Sept at $143 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
July/Dec Thai tapioca pellets changed hands at 19.10 marks per 100 kg fob Rotterdam, Jan/June 1998 at 20.50 and Jan/Dec at 21 marks fob Rotterdam.
Nov/Jan EU rapemeal traded at 27.15 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine and 27.25 fob Hamburg.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
